description: Authoritative Wawona + Exact product platform scope. Agents: when a prompt says ALL_TARGETS (or another alias), read this file. Do not hardcode the list.

targets.label: iOS
targets.notes: Phone. Machine catalog as inset-grouped root. Settings is a cover (gear). No Machines|Settings tab bar.

targets.label: iPadOS
targets.notes: Machine catalog as adaptive split. Settings is a cover (gear). Session window supported.

targets.label: macOS
targets.notes: Machine catalog is the source list. Settings is a cover (gear). Session may open in its own window. CSD or SSD.

targets.label: Android
targets.notes: Exact android crate (`wawona-android`) cargo-checks; product Canvas package wire still planned. Play Mode A. SSH sanitize live via JNI→rust when libwawona.so loads.

targets.label: Web
targets.notes: Exact `wawona-web` + agent Machines/Settings. Product Wawona web chrome dogfood.

targets.label: Windows
targets.notes: Exact `wawona-windows` cargo-checks on Darwin. MSVC package on Windows. Product ship gate separate.

targets.label: visionOS
targets.notes: Exact UI parity: build + agent.mjs visionos + smoke.mjs visionos (Wawona Settings / Caltrain). Contract tree gates; AX may stay flaky. Device refuse. Delivery deferred.

targets.label: tvOS
targets.notes: Exact UI parity: agent.mjs tvos + smoke.mjs tvos (Caltrain + --app wawona Machines/Settings). XCTests/delivery deferred. No VM/container kinds.

targets.label: watchOS
targets.notes: Exact UI parity: PresenterWatch + AgentWatch; smoke.mjs watchos (Wawona watch-settings). Sim-only; device/TS-on-watch deferred. wearable-contract.md.

targets.label: Wear OS
targets.notes: Exact UI parity: --wear APK + agent.mjs android --wear + crown; smoke.mjs wear. Round safe-area. Tiles deferred. demo-matrix-wearables.mjs.

targets.label: AsteroidOS
targets.notes: Exact UI parity: 240x240 headless agent.mjs asteroid + smoke.mjs asteroid (Wawona). Qt/QML image still Phase 6 (#246).

targets.label: Linux
targets.notes: Exact Linux host. cargo xtask build linux. Headless on macOS. Not nix build .#wawona-linux.

targets.label: CarPlay
targets.notes: Exact PresenterCarPlay + CPListTemplate from car.contract; EXACT_CARPLAY=1 fail-closed. Wawona CarPlayScene mirrors Machines glance. Never freeform Exact paint.

targets.label: Android Auto
targets.notes: Exact AndroidAutoTemplateBridge + VehicleListModel; EXACT_ANDROID_AUTO=1. Templates only.

targets.label: External display
targets.notes: Exact ExternalDisplaySceneDelegate paint-only; Wawona ExternalSceneDelegate + pointer_remote / limited_touch seat. Primary owns input.

rules: Read platforms.json whenever ALL_TARGETS or an alias appears.
Do not treat host-machine availability as the product scope.
Report a per-target matrix: implemented | verified | planned | blocked | forbidden | n/a.
Never silently omit a target; justify every non-verified cell.
Exact UI work: one app.contract; bun scripts/no-tells.mjs clean; portable symbol: roles only.
Product capability gates (VM/Desktop/Mode B) stay in wawona-platform-targets; ALL_TARGETS does not override forbidden.
VEHICLE_TARGETS and DISPLAY_TARGETS: never silent omit; entitlement cells are unsupported without EXACT_CARPLAY / EXACT_ANDROID_AUTO.
